description: Approximate, reference-led exterior model of the Gram GIF 1200 continuous ice-cream freezer.
dimensionBasis: Gram Equipment's GIF 600 & 1200 presentation gives 1950 mm overall length, 690 mm width, and 1700 +/- 30 mm nominal height for GIF 1200. The elevation drawing separates a 1720 mm cabinet from the front process-hardware zone. The model uses the 1700 mm nominal height.

references.type: manufacturer presentation mirrored by an equipment supplier
references.use: Exact GIF 1200 envelope, cabinet-to-hardware proportions, front and side elevations, model-specific front photograph, pump placement, pipe route, adjustable feet, rear connections, and 2015 revision identification.
GIF 600/1200 family construction, full stainless cabinet, integrated electrical box and HMI, self-contained refrigeration, two compressors in GIF 1200, and current family description.
GIF 600/1200 family front silhouette, dark control fascia, exposed sanitary pipe, stainless finish, and two-level process-hardware arrangement.

recognizableFeatures: Deep 1.72 m stainless cabinet with a 0.23 m front process-hardware zone.
Raised dark-grey operator fascia on the upper right with HMI, GIF 1200 label, status button, and emergency stop.
Upper discharge pump, central freezing-cylinder flange, and lower mix pump on the front face.
Polished sanitary transfer pipe joining the upper discharge pump to the central flange.
Long side service panels, high and low louver banks, recessed handles, tapered adjustable legs, and rear utility markers.

confidence.note: The exact-model manufacturer presentation supplies technical dimensions and front, side, and plan drawings.
The presentation contains a labelled GIF 1200 product photograph plus detailed pump and piping close-ups.
Panel splits, handles, and louver locations are estimated from the presentation photographs and elevations.

confidence.area: Rear, hidden mechanisms, and installed utility routing
confidence.note: Hidden systems remain cabinet volume. Rear utility markers follow the elevation drawing, while plant hoses and cables are omitted.

usage.purpose: QC floor visualization and freezer selection
usage.notes: This is a schematic exterior asset, not a fabrication, installation, maintenance, process-piping, or safety model.
